name: Reladiff
tagline: Open-source CLI and Python library for diffing large tables within or across databases.
bestFor: Engineers checking that a migrated or replicated table matches its source, from the command line or Python
description: Reladiff is an MIT-licensed fork of Datafold's archived data-diff project. Version 0.6.0 was released on PyPI on 2025-03-04.

JSON output and a Python API for automation
